notes.title: Mortem VR Update!
notes.content:
Mortem VR version 1.1 features Nightmare mode, bugfixed and a boost in performance!

The game is also going to be releasing on Oculus Store soon!
The game is on sale now, be sure to check it out!

-Daniel
